title: Deploy the app shell, backend, edge and DNS
description: In the dedicated account: app shell, the two-stage first backend, the edge stack with its certificate, and the DNS records.

comments.author: home
comments.text: App shell deployed through the pipeline 2026-11-12: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus/actions/runs/43161336433 (success). Stack humorus-app-shell CREATE_COMPLETE: Amplify app the-hallucinator-cms (WEB_COMPUTE, no repository yet, auto-build off, one production branch main), roles, no domain. Branch variables set: tenant id the-hallucinator, Cognito prefix papyrus-the-hallucinator. Waiting on person-only steps: Amplify GitHub authorization (connect the repository to the app, as for Machines on Machines) and the Google OAuth client.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Job 2 (auto-build) failed at asset publish: the console responder container image (flag defaults on). Fixed by setting all four PAPYRUS_ENABLE_* flags false in infra/site.json (PR #27/#28); the branch now has them. Auto-build is off; the first build is the two-pass first-build workflow.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Follow-up, waiting on Papyrus: the Papyrus session is changing the default so optional features are off unless enabled, and synth fails clearly when one is on without its prerequisites. Once that is released and Humorus is pinned to it, delete the four PAPYRUS_ENABLE_* = false entries from infra/site.json (cms.environment). Coordinator will say when it is released. Leave this issue open until then.
